# CLAP ABI headers

The unmodified `include/` tree and `LICENSE` are vendored from
[free-audio/clap](https://github.com/free-audio/clap) at commit
`a47f6badb49d948fd009998f28309cdab78979c9`.

CLAP is licensed under the MIT license in `LICENSE`. No network access is needed
to build Keyra's CLAP adapter. This license applies to the upstream headers and
does not grant a license to Keyra's implementation.
